traits.label: Overview
traits.text: one of the most sought-after wild mushrooms due to its excellent culinary qualities. It has a robust and distinctive shape, with a thick, swollen stipe and a large, brown cap. The flesh is firm and white, and it has a pleasant, nutty flavor. It is popular in Italian cuisine and is used in a variety of dishes, including risottos, pasta, and soups.
